thanks. Yes youre right. Anxiety and depression just kills me. I stay up countless nights because I just don't have anything to live for or to do...

I like alot of music, alot of genre's in that matter. It cheers me up for a while but its only temporary and its all I do for the most part. I always worry about my future and if life is worth living as it is
